summary: Iteration 18: Profit Dashboard, Admin Orders pricing, Profile wishlist removal, Cart pricing — 17/17 backend tests pass after fixing a critical 500 error on GET /api/admin/dashboard. All profit analytics features verified end-to-end. One frontend issue: Edit Profile back button not visible due to layout headerShown override.

critical.issue: Returned HTTP 500 — TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. MongoDB returns naive datetimes but today_start/last7/last_month are UTC-aware. Comparison in profit loop failed. FIXED in admin.py by normalising created_at with .replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) when tzinfo is None.

ui_bugs.issue: No back button or 'Edit Profile' header visible on screen. Root cause: profile/_layout.tsx sets screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }} globally for the profile group. edit.tsx sets Stack.Screen options with title: 'Edit Profile' and headerBackTitle: 'Back' but does NOT override headerShown: true, so the header is suppressed. Users have no way to navigate back from edit profile.

action_items: Fix Edit Profile back button: In /app/frontend/app/profile/edit.tsx, add headerShown: true to the Stack.Screen options so the 'Edit Profile' header and 'Back' navigation button are visible. The profile/_layout.tsx globally sets headerShown: false which suppresses the header.
Verify: After fixing edit.tsx, the header should show 'Edit Profile' title with a back chevron/button.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py (line ~143): MongoDB order.created_at is returned as naive datetime (no tzinfo). The profit loop compares it against today_start/last7/last_month which are UTC-aware. Fixed by normalising: if created.tzinfo is None: created = created.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).
profile/_layout.tsx: headerShown: false is set at group level. Any screen needing a header must explicitly set headerShown: true in its own Stack.Screen options.
orders.py POST /orders: selling_price, self_price, mrp are correctly snapshotted from product into each order item.

rca_of_issue: Bug: GET /api/admin/dashboard returned 500. RCA: In routes/admin.py profit analytics loop, the code iterates over delivered orders and compares order.created_at (a naive datetime returned by Motor/MongoDB) against today_start, last7, last_month (all datetime objects constructed with timezone.utc — they are offset-aware). Python raises TypeError when comparing naive vs aware datetimes. Fix: before comparison, check if created.tzinfo is None and if so normalise with created.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc). This is a common Motor/MongoDB pattern — Motor returns naive datetime objects by default even for UTC-stored dates.
